mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (name, description, price, stock, category, image_url, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{category}, #{imageUrl}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, stock = #{stock}, category = #{category}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
